snippet.title: Halo CE Campaign Mod - The Flood: Forgotten Exile
snippet.description:
What's going on homies and welcome back to another Halo CE mod showcase! In this video we revisit a mod we played a few years back on Halo Custom Edition, this time brought to Halo MCC. This is The Flood: Forgotten Exile, created by LockuP, heempy, and IsiFire!

Download link: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2938702672

►Become a Channel Member: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCs_n7eqIvJhdzz4vWM2aiLQ/join
►Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/c/xXBarthXx
►Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/xxbarthxx
►Twitter/X: https://twitter.com/_xXBarthXx_

Rampage through the snowy canyons of Alpha Halo, and experience the horrors of a Flood Infestation first-hand. Encounter new Covenant and Sentinel Enemies, while fighting alongside improved Flood forms.

Use enhanced melee, speed, and jumping capabilities to surprise and eliminate your foes.
Play as The Flood, the scourge of the galaxy, and crush all those who would stand before you.

This is The Flood: Forgotten Exile.

Suggested Difficulty: Normal

YOU NEED TO HAVE INSTALLED HALO CE MULTIPLAYER TO PLAY THE MOD

See Change Notes for full list of changes for v1.0.3r.

The mod has been updated to work on the newest version of MCC

Known Bugs:

*In Co-Op, due to the scripted nature of the health system it is currently shared between players. When one player takes health damage the other player also suffers from a blurry screen. This effect is purely visual.


Original Map by the TFFE Developers & Contributors:

*LoneWarrior
*Koo294
*Ahautz0r
*bourrin33
*Spiral and Heempy
*Polamee
*Elefant
*Gamma
*Delta
*BeachParty Wizard
*Dwood
*Karrde
*L0d3x
*Higuy
*Kirby
*CMT
*AdvanceBo
*MendicantBias
*Rotarna

Port by:

*IsiFire
*Spiral and Heempy
*LockuP

Outside of any immediate bug fixes that are required, v1.0.3r is likely to be the final major update to the ‘Legacy’ version of StKft. Any further changes to this version may push it beyond the realm of acceptability for those expecting a direct port of the original level. While we are interested in making further changes, we don’t believe a port of the original map is where these changes should be made. Finally, I just wanted to say thanks to everyone who offered comments, feedback and bug reports since we ported the mod to MCC. Your continued support will always be appreciated.

#Halo #HaloMCC #HaloMods #HaloMod #HaloInfinite
